metadata.purpose: Reliable websites for monitoring agents to discover, extract, and upload current business compliance forms, applications, requirements, and instructions.
reliability_policy: Prefer official Puerto Rico government .pr.gov, gobierno.pr, or agency-owned domains for extraction.
Use trusted nonprofit/legal-help sites only as secondary discovery or explanation sources; do not treat them as authoritative form sources unless they link back to an official agency page.
For portals requiring authentication, monitor public help pages and metadata, but only extract forms or requirements that are publicly accessible and legally reusable.

sources.name: Oficina de Gerencia de Permisos (OGPe)
sources.extraction_notes: Primary public OGPe landing page. Use it to discover public instructions and route authenticated or transactional permit workflows to SBP when appropriate.

sources.name: Single Business Portal
sources.extraction_notes: Portal is likely authentication-gated. Monitor public login/help text, public workflow labels, and linked guidance; do not scrape private account data.

sources.name: Departamento de Hacienda - Planillas, Formularios y Anejos
sources.extraction_notes: High-value source for downloadable forms and tax-related instructions. Preserve form numbers, tax year, revision date, and PDF/download URLs.

sources.name: Departamento de Hacienda - Comerciantes
sources.extraction_notes: Use as a topical entry point for business-facing Hacienda requirements and links into specific forms.

sources.name: Departamento de Estado - Registro de Corporaciones y Entidades
sources.extraction_notes: Monitor for filing instructions, annual report requirements, corporation forms, and links to the official electronic registry.

sources.name: Departamento de Salud
sources.extraction_notes: Use as the main official health-agency domain and discover downloadable CMS documents, requirements, and program pages.

sources.name: Salud Digital
sources.extraction_notes: Authentication-gated portal; monitor public service descriptions and help content, then route users rather than scraping account-only records.

sources.name: Oficina de Reglamentación y Certificación de Profesionales de la Salud
sources.extraction_notes: Monitor public licensing categories and renewal guidance for health professionals.

sources.name: Cuerpo de Bomberos - Formularios
sources.agency: Cuerpo de Bomberos de Puerto Rico
sources.extraction_notes: Good source for PDFs and required-document sheets. Preserve document titles, publication/revision dates, and direct PDF URLs.

sources.name: DRNA - Formularios
sources.agency: Departamento de Recursos Naturales y Ambientales
sources.extraction_notes: Monitor category pages and paginated archives for new or revised environmental forms.

sources.name: DRNA - Permisos
sources.agency: Departamento de Recursos Naturales y Ambientales
sources.extraction_notes: Specific permit-form category; prioritize over broader DRNA archive when extracting form candidates.

sources.name: DRNA - Área Calidad de Aire / Permisos
sources.agency: Departamento de Recursos Naturales y Ambientales
sources.extraction_notes: Target for air-emissions requirements; capture email-only instructions separately from downloadable forms.

sources.name: Puerto Rico Tourism Company
sources.agency: Compañía de Turismo de Puerto Rico
sources.extraction_notes: Monitor business, room-tax, program, laws, and regulations pages for tourism-sector obligations.

sources.name: Puerto Rico Tourism Company - Doing Business
sources.agency: Compañía de Turismo de Puerto Rico
sources.extraction_notes: Use as a business-facing landing page for tourism-related compliance and program links.

sources.name: CRIM 360
sources.agency: Centro de Recaudaciones de Ingresos Municipales
sources.extraction_notes: Portal content may be account-gated. Monitor public service descriptions and certification types; do not scrape taxpayer accounts.

sources.name: Corporación del Fondo del Seguro del Estado
sources.extraction_notes: Monitor employer transaction pages and certificate guidance for workers-compensation proof documents.

sources.name: ASUME - Solicitud de Certificación de Cumplimiento Patronal
sources.agency: Administración para el Sustento de Menores / Departamento de la Familia
sources.extraction_notes: Public form page for employer compliance certification. Capture field requirements and submission instructions where publicly visible.

sources.name: PR.gov Gobierno Digital
sources.agency: Puerto Rico Innovation and Technology Service / PR.gov
sources.extraction_notes: Use as a discovery index to identify official service portals; verify extracted requirements against the destination agency site.
